subject: Delete dead code in dict (#2014)
reason: Pure dead-code deletion in dict.c/dict.h with no behavior change. The deleted entry variants (no_value, keys_are_odd, embedded_entry, no_incremental_rehash, embedKey, the ENTRY_PTR_* tagged pointers), dictTwoPhaseUnlinkFind/Free, dictGetStats*, and the defrag entry callbacks have zero users in the tree: no dictType sets the removed flags (they are deleted from struct dictType, so any user would fail to compile), and the keyspace moved to hashtable.c.
